title: Advancing Education through Tutoring Systems: A Systematic Literature Review

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review categorizing past studies based on their level of ethical concerns (none, minimal, high), which includes analyzing the literature for mentions of AI fairness and algorithmic bias mitigation strategies.

Qualitative synthesis assessing tutoring system literature for issues related to equitable access, the digital divide, and the technological and financial barriers to deploying scalable systems in under-resourced educational settings.
